tha-ap265:1.1: Aḍḍhacandiya.] Tissassa kho bhagavato bodhiyā pāda-m-uttame / aḍḍhacandaṃ mayā dinnaṃ dharaṇīruhapādape. // //
tha-ap265:2.1: Dvenavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhiropayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi bodhipūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap265:3.1: Pañcavīse ito kappe Devapo nāma khattiyo / sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo. // //
tha-ap265:5.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Aḍḍhacandiyo thero i. g. a-ti.
